sources.entry: AuditZap - AI-powered website audit tool that runs 24 automated checks across SEO, performance, and site health, then generates code-level fix instructions ranked by revenue impact.

summary.name: AuditZap
summary.one_liner: AuditZap is a website audit tool that runs 40 SEO, performance, security and AI-visibility checks on a URL and writes plain-English fix instructions ranked by estimated revenue impact.
use_cases: audit a client website before handover
find SEO and performance problems on a small business site
get developer-ready fix instructions for failed checks
check whether AI assistants can crawl and cite a site
monitor a handful of sites for weekly changes
produce a PDF audit report for a client
summary.what_it_does: AuditZap crawls a site (up to 100 pages on Pro, 10 on Free), simulates mobile and desktop visits, and runs 40 checks per page. The checks cover critical issues such as broken links, missing titles and H1s, and SSL; Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP); SEO items such as Open Graph, sitemap, and structured data; quick wins such as alt text, security headers and console errors; and 9 AI Visibility checks that roll up into a single score. On Pro, each failed check gets a plain-English fix that the page says is specific to the site's CMS, ranked by impact. Free accounts get the fix for the highest-impact issue only.
notable: Ranks fixes by estimated revenue impact
Generates CMS-specific fix instructions (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow named)
9 AI Visibility checks for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews readiness
Free tier with 3 audits a month and no card needed
caveats: Free tier limits crawls to 10 pages and gives an AI fix only for the top issue
Full AI fixes, watermark-free PDFs and weekly monitoring require Pro at $29/month
Larger sites may take up to 5 minutes to audit
